The name of the MSE namespace.

title.zh: 获取指定应用无损上下线规则

descriptions.zh:
调用GetLosslessRuleByApp接口来获取指定应用的无损上下线的配置规则。

优先按AppId查询。

若AppId为空，使用RegionId+Namespace+AppName查询。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to query the rules for graceful start and shutdown of an application.

You can query the rules for graceful start and shutdown of an application preferentially by using the AppId parameter.

If the AppId parameter is left empty, you can use the RegionId, Namespace, and AppName parameters to query the rules for graceful start and shutdown of an application.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse get-lossless-rule-by-app --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --app-name example-app --namespace default --app-id hkhon1po62@c3df23522baa000 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse GetLosslessRuleByApp --region cn-hangzhou --AppId 'hkhon1po62@c3df23522baa000' --AcceptLanguage zh --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace default --AppName 'example-app'
